NOTE: The new version of this game has been released. If you wish to play the new version, visit the new link of the game, or via the group page!
https://www.roblox.com/games/123343754358863/Vietnamese-Vehicle-Driving-2

After many comments, suggestions, even demands to open the game, I've decided to re-open the game as a legacy version

Please note that the version in this game is final and will not receive any updates, nor any interaction from the staff team before the closure of this game and are for solely nostalgia purpose of the players only

The game are not in any way for sale, and every functionality and assets are as is, and are not 100% guarantee on its exact function of it and are not subjected to change.

Once again thank you for playing the Vietnamese Vehicle Driving series and once again, enjoy the game!
